title: Rams star Puka Nacua reportedly dealing with knee injury after win over Commanders, will undergo MRI

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams star Puka Nacua reportedly dealing with knee injury after win over Commanders, will undergo MRI
sources.description: The Rams don't believe that Puka Nacua tore his ACL in their Week 9 win over the Commanders, but he will undergo further testing on Monday.
